sections.title: GM17 Mechanism Coupling
sections.text: coupling is {type:rotation|screw,...}. rotation uses a signed ratio, or driverTeeth/drivenTeeth with external (external flips sign); screw uses lead (length per revolution). zeroPhase is the driver angle at driven zero; drivenZero is optional. driverRange {from,to} may span more than 360 deg and the track is returned unwrapped. This operation evaluates math only: representation native is blocked and never inferred from API presence. Use mechanism.motion-link.create to create a real link.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has schemaVersion:1, representation, type, ratio, lead, sign, zeroPhase, evaluated {driverRange, samples, unwrapped:true, track:[{driver,driven,residual?,engaged}], maxResidual?, engaged}, nativeMotionLink, units (length cm, angle rad), documentIdentity, frame, associativity, warnings, method, limitations, provenance. Gear ratio and screw lead are distinct; a disconnected follower is independent.

examples.label: External 20/40 gear over two turns
examples.output: result.sign is -1 and result.evaluated.track is unwrapped over 720 deg with driven = -0.5 * driver.

verified: Signed ratio and external sign flip
Mathematical coupling does not create or infer a native link

sections.title: GM17 Coupling Inspection
sections.text: coupling as mechanism.couple. driverValue and drivenValue are actual measured values (angle for rotation, length for screw). The expected driven value is computed from the coupling and the residual and engagement are reported.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has schemaVersion:1, actual {driver,driven}, expectedDriven, residual, engaged, type, ratio, lead, sign, zeroPhase. status is pass when engaged (residual within tolerance), else fail.

examples.label: Check an engaged pair
examples.output: result.expectedDriven.value is -0.785398 rad and result.engaged is true.

sections.title: GM17 Stop And Limit Checks
sections.text: coupling as mechanism.couple. limits declares working/program/hard driver-angle ranges. The program limit must be a distinct limit reached before the physical (hard) stop; a mechanical counter keeps engagement through the hard stop. stopSurfaces carry clearance evidence; sensorWindow must lie inside the working range. Missing declared limits are unknown, never pass.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has schemaVersion:1, checks[] with statuses pass/fail/unknown, coupling, limits, programLimitIsNotPhysicalStop. Checks are program-vs-hard, hard-stop, engagement, stop-surface-* and sensor-window.

examples.label: Program limit before hard stop
examples.output: result.checks show pass for program-vs-hard and engagement; programLimitIsNotPhysicalStop is true.

verified: Program limit distinct from physical stop
Stop-surface margin and sensor window placement
bugs: Physical stop geometry is caller-supplied clearance evidence, not measured natively

sections.title: Create a Native Revolute MotionLink
sections.text: Requires schemaVersion:1, frame:component, confirm:true, explicit distinct jointOne/jointTwo native references and positive angle expressions valueOne/valueTwo. Both joints must be unsuppressed revolute Joint/AsBuiltJoint objects in the pinned design. Optional isReversed is a strict boolean. The handler uses Autodesk's documented MotionLinks.createInput/add API and immediately reads back the created link, joints, motion types, values, reversal and native health.

sections.title: Mutation and Evidence Boundary
sections.text: This mutates the document by creating one native MotionLink; it does not move either joint or any occurrence, infer a coupling ratio, or qualify solver behavior. The created link is retained if post-create readback fails; no blind retry or rollback is offered. Run mechanism.drive-test separately to measure actual follower response and restore.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Returns motionLink native reference, both linked joint references, rotation motions, value expressions/readbacks, isReversed, healthState/errorOrWarningMessage and qualified:false. A successful creation/readback is not native solver or geometry qualification.

examples.label: Create a 1:1 rotational link
examples.requires: Open pinned design; two distinct unsuppressed native revolute joints. Mutating operation; no joint or occurrence motion is commanded.
examples.output: result.nativeMotionLink is true after `MotionLinks.add` and immediate native property readback; result.qualified remains false.

verified: Native link property readback is separate from solver qualification
bugs: Native MotionLink creation/readback remains unverified in live Fusion until the coordinated runtime deployment

sections.title: Driver-Only Sample
sections.text: Requires schemaVersion:1 and confirm:true. Provide one rotational driver, 2..240 absolute driver-angle waypoints in radians, and 1..32 distinct Joint/AsBuiltJoint observations. Each follower declares coordinate rotation|slide, ratio, phase and positive tolerance. The operation commands only the driver; followers are independently read and are never set to their expected values. Driver samples must be bounded below pi/2 between waypoints, exercise motion beyond tolerance and remain inside joint limits.

sections.title: Separate Evidence
sections.text: Returns commandedMathTrack, actualSolver samples (fresh follower joint coordinates, transforms, measured unwrapped phase and residuals), and nativeCapability separately. nativeCapability.status remains unknown and qualified is false: drive-test does not create a MotionLink and a matching track does not prove a native solver coupling. Use mechanism.motion-link.create separately, then measure behavior here. Angular phase is lifted only from successive measured angles; initial winding is unknown and aliased whole turns cannot be detected.

sections.title: Restore and Failure
sections.text: Before writes the adapter captures observed joint values and occurrence transform matrices. After success, error, cooperative cancel or budget expiration it attempts one driver restore and independently reads the full captured pose back. restore is pass only when that readback matches; setter failure, mismatch or unavailable readback reports fail/unknown. Followers and transforms are never assigned. Synchronous SDK calls cannot be remotely hard-cancelled; cleanup has a separate bounded operation count, not a hard wall-clock timeout.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Returns the versioned operation result {operation:'mechanism.drive-test',schemaVersion:1,status,passed,outcome,commandedMathTrack,actualSolver,nativeCapability,capture,restore,errors,units,limitations,documentIdentity,observations}. status is pass only when every requested driver/follower sample meets tolerance and the captured driver pose is independently restored/read back; otherwise it is fail. outcome is complete, cancelled, budget-exceeded, or error. actualSolver.status is pass/fail/unknown with measured samples; nativeCapability.status remains unknown and qualified:false because this operation does not create or qualify a MotionLink. restore.status is pass/fail/unknown and includes readback/errors. Driver restore failure, unavailable readback, incomplete/cancelled run or budget overrun is non-passing; followers and occurrence transforms are never assigned. The CLI exits nonzero for fail/unknown evidence; a transport-success envelope alone is not a pass.

sections.title: Qualification Boundary
sections.text: Offline fake solver/broker tests verify contracts and driver-only dispatch, not Fusion solver or native geometry. Real positive/negative coupling cases and restore-failure qualification on a synthetic Fusion document remain unqualified until executed through the coordinated broker runtime. A passing sampled residual is kinematic evidence only, not continuous-motion, contact, collision or physical-performance proof.

examples.label: Bounded rotational follower sample
examples.requires: Mutating confirmed sample; selected document; distinct native joints; existing refs and all driver waypoints within limits. No native coupling is created.
examples.output: result.commandedMathTrack is the intended relationship; result.actualSolver contains measured responses. result.nativeCapability.status remains unknown. result.restore is pass only after independent readback.

verified: Expected math, measured solver response and native capability remain separate
Restore is independently read back on success and abort
bugs: Real Fusion coupling and restore qualification awaits brokered MotionLink deployment; fake solver tests are not native evidence
